items.question: How long does a custom piece take?
items.answer: Two to four weeks from approved design to collection, depending on the complexity and stones. Wedding sets should be started at least three months before the date.

items.question: Can you remake my old jewellery?
items.answer: Yes. Old gold is melted and refined; its full gold value goes towards the new piece. Stones can be reused if they are sound.

items.question: Do I see the design before it is made?
items.answer: You approve a sketch and a CAD render, and for larger pieces a wax or resin model, before any gold is cast.

items.question: How is a custom piece priced?
items.answer: Gold weight at the rate on the day the design is confirmed, plus the making charge for the work involved, plus stones if any. We quote it in writing before starting.
